pub struct Engine;
pub struct CrawlRequest { pub url: String }
pub struct CrawlEvent { pub message: String }
impl Engine {
    pub async fn crawl_stream(&self, request: CrawlRequest)
        -> Result<futures_util::stream::BoxStream<'static, Result<CrawlEvent, String>>, String>
    {
        use futures_util::StreamExt;
        Ok(futures_util::stream::iter([Ok(CrawlEvent { message: request.url })]).boxed())
    }
}
